justification: Wrapper of the external tesseract binary for image_ocr (P363 c1: 'pytesseract (Apache-2.0) is the wrapper'). Optional: without it image_ocr reports UNAVAILABLE 'package' ('pip install pytesseract'); the tesseract binary itself (Apache-2.0) is installed separately by the analyst and is never downloaded or updated by V3LUM.
notes: Batch p2-G12-2. Pure Python, used unmodified; it runs only inside the core file-analysis sandbox (core/sandbox.py), never in the V3LUM process. rapidocr-onnxruntime is not used (P363 c1).
